title: The release's images are not all on this computer
body: An install writes the release's boot images and its system image. They were not all found beside the release's other files, so none of them was checked, and the installer does not ask you to confirm a write it has not checked.
Fetch the whole release from https://omamobile.org/download: its images directory, and the system image (.img.zst) beside it.
footer: The installer only asked the phone what it is. It has written nothing to it.
Start the installer again once that is done.
